# atlassian_jira_group (Resource)

Create and manage a Jira group. Requires site admin. Deleting removes the group (optionally use swap to reassign members in API; this resource does not expose swap).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "atlassian_jira_group" "example" {
  name = "terraform-managed-group"
}

output "group_id" {
  value = atlassian_jira_group.example.id
}

output "group_name" {
  value = atlassian_jira_group.example.name
}
```

## Import

Import by group name or group ID. The resource block must exist in config before importing.

```bash
terraform import atlassian_jira_group.my_group jira-administrators
```

**Import ID:** the group name (e.g. `jira-administrators`) or the numeric group ID. See [Importing resources](../import.md) for more.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Group ID (set after create).
